title: Freya and the Radiators
author: Isandro Villalobos
blurb: Casper Ishikawa, an heir cataloging a parent's silence after the funeral, has perfected the smile that ends conversations. Then a stranger at the funeral knows the family by a name nobody uses — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must translate the untranslatable sentence and live with it before the mother's memory goes entirely.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
